Personal Injury

If you were hurt because someone else was careless, I represent you against the people and insurance companies responsible.

I represent injured people in Spokane and across Eastern and Central Washington, including Spokane, Yakima, Benton, Franklin, Kittitas and Klickitat counties. I am licensed in Washington and Oregon and meet clients at my Spokane office by appointment. The first consultation is free.

How a personal injury claim works in Washington

How It Works
1

A free consultation

Tell me what happened. I will tell you honestly whether I think you have a claim worth pursuing.

2

I deal with the insurance company

Once I represent you, the adjusters talk to me. You can focus on getting better.

3

Building the claim

I gather the medical records, bills, wage loss and evidence of fault, and put a value on the claim before any offer is discussed.

4

Settlement or trial

Most claims resolve by settlement. If the insurer will not pay a fair amount, the case goes to court.

Fees

Personal injury cases are handled on a contingency fee, which means my fee is a percentage of what you recover and there is no attorney fee if there is no recovery. How case costs are handled is set out in the written fee agreement before any work begins.

Hurt in an Accident?

Claims have deadlines, and evidence is easier to gather early. Call or send a message and I will get back to you.
